title: OOH-AHH Validation
description: Validation state and feedback that can be attached to trace events, visualization nodes, timeline items, or AI mentor context.

expected.description: Expected value, behavior, event shape, or concept for this validation point.

actual.description: Observed value, behavior, event shape, or concept for this validation point.

misconception.description: Optional misconception label or short explanation inferred from the validation result.

severity.description: How strongly this issue should affect the learning flow.

source.description: System component that produced the validation result.

related_event_ids.description: Trace event ids related to this validation result.

metadata.description: Extension point for future validation details.
